messages:
anya: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a predictive/anticipatory precision ramp instead of reactive flips. runtime forecasts short-term quality drift and ramps precision up preemptively for a window. want to discuss schema, telemetry needs, and ops controls.
sam: interesting. where does the forecasting model live? tiny model in runtime or offline service? runtime models cost us latency and memory.
jordan: i like offline forecast with a tight sync TTL. runtime can ingest a 3-state signal: forecast_low, forecast_medium, forecast_high. minimal runtime logic picks profile based on that plus immediate signals.
lia: requires new profile fields: forecast_ttl_seconds, forecast_weight, ramp_window_requests. Example snippet: {"version":"v1","profiles":[{"id":"fp8-anticipatory","forecast_ttl_seconds":"60","forecast_weight":"0.7","ramp_window_requests":"50","min_samples":"10"}]}
ops-sre: ops concerns: preemptive upgrades increase spend before degradation confirmed. need per-customer spend cap and explicit opt-in. Also require an audit log of forecast decisions.
anya: agree. add optional fields: customer_opt_in=true/false, spend_cap_tokens, audit_event_hook. Also require a manual opt-out precedence: customer_pin > manual_override > forecast_ramp > reactive.
sam: runtime implementation: keep forecast_state tag per request, maintain a short token-budget counter for forecasted upgrades to honor spend cap, and a conservative rollback if telemetry disproves forecast.
jordan: telemetry side: forecasting service consumes recent degscore time series and model outputs a probability of near-term degradation. we attach probability and reason codes to forecast events.
lia: tests: synthetic bursts, false-positive rate targets, and a canary that runs forecast_only (no upgrade) for 24h to validate precision to cost tradeoffs.
ops-sre: runbook bullets: - alert if forecast_upgrades >> confirmed_degradation (FP rate) - nightly report on forecast precision vs actual - CLI override: `rictl quant forecast --service svc --enable false` - emergency kill switch at global routing layer.
anya: next steps: i will draft full spec with sample API events and schema; @sam mock runtime hook; @jordan sketch telemetry model API; @lia add test plan; @ops-sre draft ops guardrails. follow-up 30m tomorrow. closing for now :thumbsup:
